content: IEEE Day 2025 is happening on October 1st, 2025. It's an annual celebration of IEEE's founding and achievements in advancing technology for humanity.
The event will be held at NSBM Green University. IEEE NSBM Student Branch, Computer Society Chapter, and Women in Engineering Affinity Group are organizing this celebration.
You can register online via the /register page. The registration includes access to all workshops, networking sessions, and refreshments throughout the day.
The event features exciting workshops on emerging technologies, keynote speakers from the industry, technical competitions, and networking opportunities with professionals and students.
IEEE Day 2025 theme focuses on innovation, technology advancement, and building connections within the IEEE community. Participants will learn about latest trends in engineering and technology.
The event is sponsored by various technology companies and includes opportunities for career guidance, internships, and job opportunities for students and recent graduates.
IEEE NSBM Student Branch has been actively organizing technical events throughout the year. This IEEE Day celebration is one of our flagship events showcasing the vibrant IEEE community.
The Women in Engineering (WIE) Affinity Group will be conducting special sessions on diversity in technology and career development for women in engineering fields.
Computer Society Chapter will showcase cutting-edge projects and research in computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and software engineering.
The event schedule includes morning registration, opening ceremony, technical sessions, lunch break, afternoon workshops, networking session, and closing ceremony with prizes.
